title: Dust Storm!
kid_text: A dust storm is covering the solar panels! They make less electricity until the storm passes.
lesson: Dust blocks sunlight, so the panels make less electricity. Real Martian dust storms can cover the whole planet!
simplification_note: Real Martian dust storms can last for months. We shortened it to 2 Sols for gameplay.

title: Oxygen Leak!
kid_text: Oh no! There is a small crack in the habitat. Oxygen is leaking out!
lesson: A leak wastes oxygen. In space, every molecule of air is precious because there is no atmosphere to breathe outside.
simplification_note: ISS astronauts train for rapid leak detection. Real leaks are patched immediately.

title: Radiation Warning!
kid_text: The Sun just sent dangerous particles our way! Your shield generator can protect the crew.
lesson: Solar energetic particles are invisible but dangerous. Without shielding, astronauts get harmful radiation.
simplification_note: Based on real Solar Energetic Particle events. The game simplifies radiation exposure into a shield check — real radiation effects are more complex.
